newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices ease on world market slump.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices ease on world market slump.

text.p: Indian copper prices eased on Friday with ready copper down 50 rupees at 11,900 rupees per quintal as world markets continued to fall, dealers said.
Tin and nickel also fell while lead was firm.
Dealers said overseas copper has fallen to a two-month low.

They said tin and nickel fell on profit-taking. Tin fell by 100 rupees to 35,900 rupees per quintal and nickel by the same margin at 39,300 rupees. Lead gained by 50 rupees to 5,000 rupees on a shortage of ready stock.
The market is closed on Monday and Tuesday for local festivals.
